functionality: typosquatting, where malicious actors create packages with names strikingly similar to legitimate ones to deceive developers
download and run additional malicious scripts
scan for targets and spread through the network
operational_techniques: execution of malicious payloads based on the host operating system
impact: initial access to the internal network of the developer
deployment of second-stage payloads like ransomware
mitigation_measures: check systems for Cobalt Strike beacons and Linux backdoors
